subject: Render options ABI request: n2mb_draw_v3 + per-job draw-parameter fields
body:
Exact render-side ABI request for DELTA3 item3 (after textures n2r v3 code is present):

1. compute bridge: add additive
   int n2mb_draw_v3(uintptr_t,const struct tegu_generic_draw_shader *,
    const struct tegu_generic_draw_request *,const struct n2r_texture_resources *,
    const struct n2r_draw_options *,uint64_t *,unsigned *);
   It should call n2r_validate_v3/n2r_build_v3 through the same draw_locked path and
   preserve n2mb_draw/v2 bytes. Render can then call it weakly like v2.
2. Dispatch/request storage: add per-job fields (or an additive request struct) for
   signed vertex_base, uint32 base_instance, and draw flags. renderArgs are full
   (variant index + target args), and generic_job_ui.h is shared. Preferred:
   uint32_t genericDrawFlags; int32_t genericVertexBase; uint32_t genericBaseInstance
   in Dispatch, retained through cleanup, copied by snapshot and read by submit.
3. shader facts: tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options returns pair2 flags and
   tegu_mali_varying_info. Render needs a place to store flat-shading flag and the
   selected varying list; either extend tegu_generic_draw_shader with additive
   fields/constant (preferred) or pass them in the request sidecar. n2r only needs
   N2R_DRAW_FLAT_SHADING plus existing varying_bytes for now; extended varying
   slots are a compiler/link contract, not n2r descriptor data.
4. semantics: for VS VertexIndex + nonzero vertexStart, render will stop rejecting
   only when n2mb_draw_v3 is available. It will keep q->vertex as the existing
   per-vertex rebased attribute base, pass vertex_base=draw->vertex_start (or
   baseVertex when indexed), keep primitive base_vertex_offset zero, and set
   DRAW_PARAMETERS compile option. For flat/noperspective, it will compile with
   EXTENDED_VARYINGS, set N2R_DRAW_FLAT_SHADING when pair2 has flat, and keep
    noperspective in the compiler layout.
5. tests: render host fixture must prove nonzero start VertexIndex maps to FAU
   byte64 and attribute rebasing exactly once; flat first-proving must appear in
   TILER_CONTEXT word2 bit18; no production change until the bridge/request fields
   exist. Please ACK names/placement.
